obligations.statement: Convert the requested index without signed truncation and require index < current typed-array length before computing an access offset.
obligations.guard_relation: unsigned index/length validation dominates the element-size and byte-offset arithmetic
obligations.effect: prevents overflow or wraparound from turning an invalid index into an in-range access offset
limitations: Primary-file binding; the published fix also touches related runtime and stub paths.

notes: Created after reading the fix patch; not an independent holdout.
